must_identify.item: nginx fails to start with an [emerg] unknown directive error
must_identify.evidence: This caused nginx to fail config validation at startup with `nginx: [emerg] unknown directive "proxy_conect_timeout"`, terminating the container with exit code 1 and triggering CrashLoopBackOff [8, 9].

must_identify.item: The bad directive is proxy_conect_timeout in the frontend-nginx ConfigMap
must_identify.evidence: The root cause was a typo in the ConfigMap frontend-nginx, which supplies the mounted nginx configuration at /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf: the directive `proxy_connect_timeout` was misspelled as `proxy_conect_timeout` on line 9 [10].

notes: The RCA gives no explicit remediation (it never says to correct the directive or restore the ConfigMap), so the fix could not be scored. It also does not warn that the old pods will fail on their next restart; it only says they were unaffected.

reviewer_ai.reviewer: claude-opus-5-5 subagent (AI review, not a person)
reviewer_ai.notes: Both items are met with the exact [emerg] line. No remediation is stated.

fix_from_suggestions.best_suggestion: Fix typo in `frontend-nginx` ConfigMap and restart rollout
fix_from_suggestions.reason: It changes proxy_conect_timeout to proxy_connect_timeout in the frontend-nginx ConfigMap and restarts the frontend deployment, which is exactly the first acceptable fix and addresses the root cause.
